title: Pure Water San Diego construction progress!
description:
Momentum in motion 💧

Work is progressing across Pure Water San Diego as crews complete key sections throughout the project! Recent milestones include pipeline connections, pump station improvements, and the start of final road resurfacing around Bay Park.

By capturing and purifying wastewater that would otherwise be discharged, Pure Water San Diego is helping reduce ocean discharges while safely conveying and treating recycled water. Each step moves us closer to a more sustainable, locally controlled water supply for San Diego, reducing dependence on imported water and strengthening reliability for our communities.

#CityOfSanDiego #PureWater
